industry: Digital beamforming technology for 5G and mmWave communications
summary: Företag 14 develops digital beamforming solutions, RFICs and software for millimeter-wave wireless communications. Its technology is designed to improve performance, capacity and energy efficiency in 5G and future wireless networks.
partnership_signal: active technology and capital market partnerships
target_market: Global 5G, mmWave and next-generation wireless communications market
strategy_notes: Focused on commercializing proprietary digital beamforming technology and expanding adoption through licensing, semiconductor integration and strategic industry collaborations.
technology_notes: Develops fully digital beamforming architectures, RF front-end products and intellectual property for millimeter-wave communications used in 5G and future wireless systems.
risk_notes: Dependent on adoption of mmWave technologies, commercialization success, access to capital, semiconductor industry cycles and competition from larger wireless technology providers.
